verses: Around the pools, the islets o'er, Fast she plucks white southernwood, To help the sacrificial store; And for our prince does service good.
Where streams among the valleys shine, Of southernwoods she plucks the white; And brings it to the sacred shrine, To aid our prince in solemn rite.
In headdress high, most reverent, she The temple seeks at early dawn. The service o'er, the headdress see To her own chamber slow withdrawn.
